review.notes: Code-fence structure balanced (no fences); Algorithms 1-2 are rendered as plain numbered lines with their math intact. Every physical page's extracted text diffed against the OCR markdown with normalized n-gram alignment; pages 2, 6 and 11 rendered (130 dpi) to verify the print's own misspellings ('genralizability', 'mutimodal', 'digial', 'uinified') and the dropped Table 6 footnote body. All 11 tables exist as OCR HTML tables; flagged table/chart gaps were rowspan, accented-name (Sébastien, Sağnak) and figure-label artifacts (Figure 1 author-role tags, Figure 9/10 axis labels, SimplerEnv task names). The print's 'environments(see Fig. 1 right)' missing space and the 'urlhttps://...huggingface.co/spaces/huggingface.co/spaces/...' reference quirk are preserved as printed. The project-page footnote URL survives as the standalone 'https://microsoft.github.io/Magma' line; only its footnote marker digit is absent, which was left unchanged.
